neighbours.label: Start/begin markers in programming identifiers, comments, and procedural documentation.
fire: The parser calls `_start_element` whenever an opening tag arrives from the input stream.
Before inserting the records, the handler invokes `transaction.begin()` on the database connection.
The next comment reads, 'Start by advancing the cursor past the header.'
For each example, the runner invokes `report_start` with the current test name.
Once configuration is loaded, call `worker.start()` to launch the background processing loop.
Within the rendering routine, `canvas.begin()` opens a fresh drawing operation.
After validating the attributes, the parser enters `_start_summary` to open the summary section.
The setup instructions say to start the command interpreter before sending plotting commands.
quiet: Whenever a closing tag arrives, the parser calls `_end_element` with the element name.
After inserting the records, the database handler invokes `transaction.commit()` on the connection.
A nearby comment reads, 'Finish by advancing the cursor past the trailer.'
Upon completing an example, the runner invokes `report_success` with the current test name.
When shutdown is requested, call `worker.stop()` to halt the background processing loop.
Inside the drawing routine, `canvas.end()` closes the current rendering operation.
Having processed the final attributes, the parser enters `_end_summary` to close the summary section.
The cleanup instructions say to close the command interpreter after sending plotting commands.
